title: US Air Force Completes Force Design 2026: A Classified Plan Built Around Technology, Autonomy and Integration
excerpt: The US Air Force has completed Force Design 2026, its plan for generating combat power in a future high-end war. The plan is classified and no public summary has been released.
rank_math_title: US Air Force unveils Force Design 2026 | Envanter Medya
rank_math_description: The US Air Force completed the classified Force Design 2026, replacing One Force Design 2024, with a focus on technology, autonomy and integration. What is known and what is not.
